description: larp utility addon for Meteor Client

releases.notes:
## Additions
- **VaultESP** - *ESP & notifications for ominous vaults.* Also capable of Baritone pathing to the nearest in-range vault when a keybind is pressed.
- **ChatPrefix** - *Allows you to change Meteor's client-message prefix to whatever you like.*
- **2b2t Clock** - *A config setting which adds a clock widget to 2b2t server-list entries, showing the current overworld time on the server, as reported by api.2b2t.vc/time.*

---
## Improvements
- **AdBlocker** - *Added a player whitelist setting.* Whitelisted players will not be ignored or have their messages removed by AdBlocker.
- **Air Place** - *Adds some QoL features to Meteor's Air Place module, including a setting for the offhand bypass as well as the ability to hold down ctrl while scrolling your mouse wheel to alter the custom placement range.*
- **Item Physics** - *Adds item tumble animations to the Random Rotation feature in Meteor's Item Physics module.*

---
## Fixes
- **RocketMan** - *Fixed takeoff assist feature for 2b2t's current anticheat.*
- **RocketJump** - *Fixed auto takeoff logic for 2b2t's current anticheat.*
- **Meteorites** - *Fixed a bug where exiting cheat mode with invulnerability did not properly clear the player's iFrames.*
- **Item Physics** - *Fixed a rare crash bug that could occur with Meteor's Item Physics module.*

---

## Additions

- **[1.21.4 Support](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/81729a917d0659c0eea97b3543836bce3f88e42d)**
- **[RocketJump](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/modules/RocketJump.java)** - *Uses a rocket & elytra to give you a boosted "jump".* Good for accessing out-of-reach areas gracefully, or as an easy way to charge up mace damage.
- **[RapidFire](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/modules/RapidFire.java)** - *Automatically fires every crossbow in your hotbar / inventory, spaced out by a configurable delay.*
- **[Archaeology](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/modules/Archaeology.java)** - *ESP for dig sites, automatic brushing of suspicious blocks & accidental breakage prevention.*
- **[BetterTooltips Durability](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/mixin/meteor/BetterTooltipsMixin.java)** - *Raw damage and true durability settings have been added to Meteor's BetterTooltips.*
- **[ExpThrower Level Cap](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/mixin/meteor/ExpThrowerMixin.java)** - *Adds a setting to ExpThrower to automatically disable the module when a specified level is reached.*
- **[Disable Meteor Telemetry](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/mixin/meteor/OnlinePlayersMixin.java)** - *Config setting that disables the periodic telemetry pings for Meteor's online player api.*
- **[Packet-Spam Anti-Kick](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/blob/main/src/main/java/dev/stardust/managers/PacketSpamManager.java)** - *Config setting that prevents most kicks from sending invalid QUICK_MOVE packets on 2b2t.*

- **[IllegalDisconnect](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/d21f9d226b50f066aa3d581cac0c6b570ce2df25)** - *AutoLog with IllegalDisconnect enabled now falls back on a regular disconnect if the illegal disconnect method fails.*
- **[LoreLocator](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/3e815025ae7a0dda35f22f88737080cebe531cbd)** - *Now capable of highlighting illegal tropical fish with black as one of their colors.*
- **[StashBrander](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/fdb13ea0e3cb4b229e1264c9be595b508eac9865)** - *Added a setting to automatically enable ExpThrower when you have insufficient levels to continue.*
- **[RocketMan](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/71b1ccb8491bca7d9634932ecb03cfa8c4e6f5e0)** - *Added improved takeoff assist settings, and a lava pool escape setting for the Nether.*
- **[AntiToS](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/2277d40830d14f1ca85db4978dd4353365117f34)** - *Added a NoRender mode for signs containing blacklisted text.*
- **[ChatSigns](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/ce7a7817db223aa415e4338b3d0453f98d3aeb2b)** - *Now capable of adding waypoints to your Xaero map when a large-enough cluster of signs is encountered.*
- **[TreasureESP](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commit/3bd215ac7e20dd068777545cf512698cd3fef743)** - *Now capable of adding waypoints to your Xaero map when a buried treasure chest is found.*

*For a full list of changes since the last release, please see the [commit history](https://github.com/0xTas/stardust/commits/main/).*
